lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text:
Vulture here.
Sterna, Bear — status and position.

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text:
Sterna, copy. Outboard passageway, port side.
Level with the manifold. Tutto tranquillo.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text: Bear. Three steps behind her, covering the aft ladder.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: Contact?

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text:
Nothing.
And that's what's strange.

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text:
I swept all three hundred meters of deck with thermal.
Not one body. Ni uno solo.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text: And there's no sound inside.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text:
A ship this size always makes noise, boss. Pumps, generators, the hull working.
The Mariner is silent.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text:
Listen carefully.
There is something inside this vessel.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: Move slow and clear every corner.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text: What about the bridge, boss? Find anything up there?

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text:
The bridge is compromised.
Controls destroyed. The ship is adrift.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text:
Great.
Three hundred meters of tanker with no rudder.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text: And loaded. That doesn't stop on its own, Vulture.

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text: Compromised how?

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text:
Is anyone alive up there, sir?
What happened?

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: Who said that?

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text: Bambi.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text:
Deer. The Coast Guard kid.
The one who's left.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text:
I forgot about the kid.
Shit...

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: Coast Guard. What happened to your team?

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text: There were five of us.

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text:
We came up the starboard side.
They were on us the second we went in.

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text:
Crew. Unarmed.
We didn't read them as a threat.

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text:
They caught us off guard.
We were overrun before any of us could react.

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text:
It took less than two minutes.
I'm the only one who walked out.

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text:
Attends.
Five armed men, against people with no weapons?

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text: They looked hungry.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text:
Boss.
They sent us out here over a draft that didn't add up.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text: This isn't crude smuggling.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: No. It isn't.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: Get this straight, all three of you: this stopped being a seizure.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text:
We're not here to count barrels.
We're here to find out what is happening on this ship.

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text: Did you reach Command?

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text:
I tried. Something is jamming long range.
All we have is this channel.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: We're on our own, gentlemen.

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text: Merde.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text:
I'm going straight down to the lower levels.
You move along the deck and report anything out of the ordinary.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text: Copy. We're headed for B Deck.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text:
It's the accommodation block. Most of the berths are there.
If anyone on this ship is still alive, they're there.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text: And if the hatches are dogged shut, I'll open them.

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text:
Sir. The bridge.
You didn't answer me whether there was anyone up—

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: Bear. Sterna.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text:
As of now you're his babysitters.
His safety is on you. Anything happens to him, you answer to me.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text: We always get the good jobs.

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text:
With respect, sir.
I didn't come here to be looked after.

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text: I won't be dead weight.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text:
I like the kid.
He's got patriotic spirit.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text:
Loyalty to a flag isn't worth much in the middle of the ocean, Bear.
What's worth something is coming back alive.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text:
Keep the channel open.
Vulture out.
